senses.title: The science of humankind
senses.definition: the academic discipline that studies humans across all times and places, from biology to culture
senses.definitionCN: 研究一切时空之中人类的学科，涵盖生物性与文化
senses.example: Anthropology treats a wedding ring and a wisdom tooth as equal evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 人类学把婚戒与智齿视为同等的证据。
senses.why: Anthropos 'human' plus -logy 'study' is literally 'the study of humans', all of them, everywhere.
senses.whyCN: anthropos「人」加 -logy「研究」，字面即「人的研究」，无所不包。

senses.title: A particular account of human nature
senses.definition: a theory or doctrine about what human beings are, as in philosophy or theology
senses.definitionCN: 哲学或神学中关于人之本质的理论或学说
senses.example: The book's anthropology sees people as storytellers first.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书的人性观首先把人看作讲故事的动物。
senses.why: Because -logy also means a body of teaching, theology and philosophy borrowed the word for their views of the human.
senses.whyCN: -logy 亦可指一套学说，神学与哲学便借该词指各自的人观。

intro.en: Anthropology joins Greek anthropos 'human being' with -logia 'study, discourse': the study of humankind.
intro.cn: anthropology 由希腊语 anthropos「人」加 -logia「研究、论述」构成：人之学。

items.en: The root *bher- meant 'to carry'; Greek anthropos likely means 'the one who carries himself upright'.
items.cn: 词根 *bher- 意为「承担」；希腊语 anthropos 大意是「直立承担者」。

items.en: Anthropos was the common Greek word for a human being, man or woman.
items.cn: anthropos 是希腊语指人的常用词，不分男女。

items.en: The suffix -logia meant 'talk, account, study', as in theology and biology.
items.cn: 后缀 -logia 意为「言谈、论述、研究」，如 theology、biology。

items.en: English used anthropologie early for talk of human nature; the modern science was fixed in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 英语早期用 anthropologie 谈人性；现代科学意义定型于十九世纪。

items.en: The discipline now splits into cultural, social, linguistic, and biological branches.
items.cn: 该学科如今分为文化、社会、语言与生物等分支。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers anth- words that mean flower and the anthropos family; the near-meaning group gathers human sciences.
note.cn: 形近组收意为「花」的 anth- 词与 anthropos 词族；近义组收研究人的学科。

entries.definition: A collection of writings; near twin in sound, but its root is anthos 'flower'.
entries.definitionCN: 选集；读音为近亲，但词根是 anthos「花」。

entries.definition: A manlike ape; shares anthropos with a different suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 类人猿；共享 anthropos，后缀不同。

entries.definition: The measurement of human bodies, a branch of physical anthropology.
entries.definitionCN: 人体测量学，体质人类学的分支。

entries.definition: The study of modern societies and social institutions.
entries.definitionCN: 研究现代社会与社会制度的学科。

entries.definition: The comparative study of peoples and cultures.
entries.definitionCN: 对各民族与文化的比较研究。

entries.definition: The study of past human life through material remains.
entries.definitionCN: 通过物质遗存研究人类过去的学科。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the two Greek halves and the branches of the discipline.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用两个希腊成分以及学科的分支。

normal.en: anthropos + logy: the study of humans, literally.
normal.cn: anthropos 加 logy：字面即「人的研究」。

normal.en: Anthropology covers bones and weddings alike.
normal.cn: 人类学既管骨头也管婚礼。

normal.en: Its branches: cultural, social, linguistic, physical.
normal.cn: 分支：文化、社会、语言、体质。

normal.en: Anthropoid and anthropomorphic share the human root.
normal.cn: anthropoid 与 anthropomorphic 共享「人」词根。

normal.en: Anthology is the flower word, not the people word.
normal.cn: anthology 是「花」词，不是「人」词。

abstract.en: Picture a table with a skull, a pot, and a diary side by side.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上并放颅骨、陶罐与日记。

abstract.en: Picture one classroom holding four maps of the same world.
abstract.cn: 想象同一间教室挂着四张同一世界的不同地图。

abstract.en: Picture a lens zooming out until all humans fit inside it.
abstract.cn: 想象镜头拉远，直到全人类都框进画面。

examples.en: She switched from biology to anthropology in her second year.
examples.cn: 她大二时从生物学转到人类学。

examples.en: Anthropology began with travelers' tales of distant peoples.
examples.cn: 人类学始于旅行者对远方民族的记述。

examples.en: The court relied on forensic anthropology to identify the remains.
examples.cn: 法庭依靠法医人类学鉴定遗骸身份。

sensesIntro.cn: 由人之科学扩展到关于人之本质的任何学说。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the whole of humankind spread out for study on one table
core.cn: 核心意象：全人类被摊在同一张桌上供人研究

branches.en: The science line: fieldwork, museums, and comparative study.
branches.cn: 科学线：田野、博物馆与比较研究。

branches.en: The doctrine line: philosophy and theology state their own anthropology.
branches.cn: 学说线：哲学与神学各有其人观。

branches.en: Both answer the same question: what is a human being?
branches.cn: 两者回答同一问题：人是什么？

branches.en: The four-field model holds culture, society, language, and biology together.
branches.cn: 四分支模型把文化、社会、语言与生物性合在一起。

branches.en: The discipline refuses to rank cultures, only to compare them.
branches.cn: 这门学科只比较文化，不排高低。

intro.en: The word joins a Greek root with one great suffix: anthropos plus -logy.
intro.cn: 这个词把希腊词根与一个重要后缀相连：anthropos 加 -logy。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin family; the entries record the Greek parts.
latinIntro.cn: 该词没有拉丁词族；条目记录希腊语成分。

items.example: It supplies the human in anthropology.
items.exampleCN: 它为 anthropology 提供人义。

items.example: It joins the root to the suffix.
In anthology it means flower, a different root.
items.exampleCN: 在 anthology 中意为花，是另一词根。

definition_en: a medicine that kills bacteria or stops them growing, or able to destroy bacteria
core_image: 一个小小的盾牌挡在细胞前，抵御看不见的细菌大军
scene: 药房柜台后，药剂师把药盒递过来叮嘱按时服用。The doctor prescribed a course of antibiotics for the chest infection.
sceneCN: 这里 antibiotic 是「抗生素」（第 1 个义项：杀灭细菌的药物）；句意为医生为胸部感染开了一个疗程的抗生素。

derivatives.zh: 同族词，义为「抗菌的」
同前缀词，义为「抗体」
由本词加 -gram 构成，义为「药敏谱」

senses.title: A bacteria-killing medicine
senses.definition: a drug, often made by or derived from microorganisms, that destroys bacteria or checks their growth
senses.definitionCN: 一种常由微生物产生或衍生的药物，可杀灭细菌或抑制其生长
senses.example: Penicillin was the first antibiotic to change medicine.
senses.exampleCN: 青霉素是第一种改变医学面貌的抗生素。
senses.why: Greek bios 'life' plus anti- 'against' plus -tic gives 'against life'; the word first meant any life-poisoning substance, then narrowed to bacteria.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 bios「生命」加 anti-「对抗」加 -tic 得「对抗生命」；该词初指一切毒害生命之物，后收窄为对付细菌。

senses.title: Destroying bacteria
senses.definition: able to kill bacteria or prevent their multiplication
senses.definitionCN: 能够杀菌或阻止细菌繁殖的
senses.example: The coating has antibiotic properties that keep wounds clean.
senses.exampleCN: 这层涂层具有抗菌特性，可保持伤口清洁。
senses.why: The adjective keeps the original relation: the substance stands against bacterial life.
senses.whyCN: 形容词保留了本原关系：该物质「对抗」细菌的生命。

intro.en: Antibiotic is built from Greek anti- 'against', bios 'life', and the adjective suffix -tic.
intro.cn: antibiotic 由希腊语 anti-「对抗」、bios「生命」与形容词后缀 -tic 构成。

items.en: The root *gweih3- meant 'to live', the same root that gave Latin vita and Greek bios.
items.cn: 词根 *gweih3- 意为「活」，拉丁语 vita 与希腊语 bios 同出一源。

items.en: Bios meant 'life', and it fills English with biology, biography, and symbiosis.
items.cn: bios 意为「生命」，充斥于英语的 biology、biography、symbiosis。

items.en: Anti- meant 'against, in place of', as in antifreeze and antidote.
items.cn: anti- 意为「对抗、替代」，如 antifreeze、antidote。

items.en: French bacteriologists coined antibiose for life against life: one microbe destroying another.
items.cn: 法国细菌学家造 antibiose，指生命对抗生命：一种微生物毁灭另一种。

items.en: With penicillin in the 1940s, antibiotic named the wonder drugs themselves.
items.cn: 二十世纪四十年代青霉素问世后，antibiotic 用以命名这类灵药。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers anti- and bios words; the near-meaning group gathers germ-fighting substances.
note.cn: 形近组收 anti- 与 bios 词汇；近义组收抗微生物药物。

entries.definition: A protein the body makes against a specific invader; made by you, not in a factory.
entries.definitionCN: 机体针对特定入侵者产生的蛋白；由身体自造而非工厂生产。

entries.definition: The study of life; shares bios with a friendlier prefix.
entries.definitionCN: 生物学；共享 bios，前缀友好得多。

entries.definition: Against decay and infection; ends similarly, but the root is sepsis 'putrefaction'.
entries.definitionCN: 抗感染的；词尾相近，词根是 sepsis「腐败」。

entries.definition: Directed against bacteria specifically, often of soaps and coatings.
entries.definitionCN: 专指对抗细菌，多用于皂类与涂层。

entries.definition: Wider still: against microbes including fungi and viruses.
entries.definitionCN: 更广：对抗包括真菌病毒在内的微生物。

entries.definition: The first great antibiotic, from mold.
entries.definitionCN: 第一种重大抗生素，源于霉菌。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the anti- prefix, the bios life root, and the hospital phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用前缀 anti-、词根 bios「生命」，以及医院常用语。

normal.en: anti + bio + tic: against (bacterial) life.
normal.cn: anti 加 bio 加 tic：对抗（细菌的）生命。

normal.en: Antibiotics kill bacteria, not viruses.
normal.cn: 抗生素杀细菌，不杀病毒。

normal.en: Biology, antibiotic, symbiosis all share bios, life.
normal.cn: biology、antibiotic、symbiosis 都共享 bios「生命」。

normal.en: Antibiotic resistance is when bacteria learn to survive the drug.
normal.cn: antibiotic resistance 指细菌学会在药物下存活。

normal.en: A course means finishing every pill the doctor gave.
normal.cn: a course 指把医生开的药全部吃完。

abstract.en: Picture a shield stamped with a minus sign pressed against a swarm of dots.
abstract.cn: 想象一面印着减号的盾牌顶住一群点状细菌。

abstract.en: Picture a mold dish where a clear ring stops the spreading dots.
abstract.cn: 想象培养皿中一圈透明地带拦住了扩散的点群。

abstract.en: Picture a tiny doorman refusing entry to bacteria only.
abstract.cn: 想象一个小门卫只拒绝细菌入内。

examples.en: Take the full course of antibiotics even if you feel better.
examples.cn: 即使好转也要服完整个疗程的抗生素。

examples.en: Overuse of antibiotics breeds resistant bacteria.
examples.cn: 滥用抗生素催生耐药菌。

examples.en: The ointment has mild antibiotic action.
examples.cn: 这种药膏有温和的抗菌作用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安泰拜奥替」——安泰（安康）靠拜拜奥妙细菌换来，就是「抗生素」

root: 希腊语 anti-（对抗）+ bios（生命）+ -tic（形容词后缀）→ 对抗生命的物质 → 对抗细菌的药物；二十世纪随青霉素普及定型。

sensesIntro.en: From a general life-poison the word narrowed to the bacteria-fighting drug, and gave back an adjective.
sensesIntro.cn: 由泛指的毒害生命之物收窄为抗细菌药物，并回赠一个形容词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: life turned against life, a poison drawn as a shield
core.cn: 核心意象：以生命制生命，一剂被画成盾牌的「毒药」

branches.en: The pharmacy line: the drug that emptied the fever wards.
branches.cn: 药房线：让发热病房清空的那种药。

branches.en: The material line: coatings and soaps with the same power.
branches.cn: 材料线：拥有同样力量的涂层与皂类。

branches.en: Both stand anti- against bacterial bios.
branches.cn: 两者都以 anti- 对抗细菌的 bios。

branches.en: The narrow line: antibiotics miss viruses entirely.
branches.cn: 界限线：抗生素对病毒完全无效。

branches.en: The resistance line: every use trains the survivors.
branches.cn: 耐药线：每一次使用都在训练幸存菌。

intro.en: The word shows three Greek pieces: anti-, bio-, and -tic.
intro.cn: 这个词含三个希腊成分：anti-、bio- 与 -tic。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin family; the entries record the Greek source words.
latinIntro.cn: 该词没有拉丁词族；条目记录希腊语源头词。

items.example: It supplies the opposition in antibiotic.
items.exampleCN: 它为 antibiotic 提供对抗义。

items.meaning: relating to, having the nature of
items.exampleCN: 它构成 dramatic 与 antibiotic。

items.example: It forms antibody, the body's own weapon.
items.exampleCN: 它构成抗体 antibody，身体的自造武器。

items.example: It forms biology, the study of life.
It shares bios but means cooperation, not war.
items.exampleCN: 它共享 bios，但意为合作而非对抗。

items.example: It forms antidote, given against poison.

definition_en: a weather system with high pressure at its center, where winds spiral outward and skies stay calm
core_image: 一锅缓慢向外旋开的漩涡，中心晴朗无云
scene: 连日的雨停了，预报图上一个巨大的圆盘正缓缓盖上这座城市。A summer anticyclone brought a week of clear, windless skies.
sceneCN: 这里 anticyclone 是「反气旋」（第 1 个义项：中心高压、气流向外的天气系统）；句意为夏季反气旋带来一周晴朗无风的天气。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ic 构成，义为「反气旋的」
同族基础词，义为「气旋；低压系统」

senses.title: A high-pressure weather system
senses.definition: an area of high atmospheric pressure around which winds circulate outward, bringing settled weather
senses.definitionCN: 高气压区，风绕其中心向外旋转，带来稳定天气
senses.example: Fog formed overnight under the anticyclone.
senses.exampleCN: 反气旋控制下，夜间起了雾。
senses.why: The winds run opposite to a cyclone, so the prefix anti- 'against' was attached to cyclone 'wheel'.
senses.whyCN: 风向与气旋相反，所以在 cyclone「轮转」前加上 anti-「反向」前缀。

senses.title: Opposing a cyclone in direction of spin
senses.definition: describing winds or rotation running opposite to the direction of a cyclone in the same hemisphere
senses.definitionCN: 描述在同一半球内与气旋旋转方向相反的风或环流
senses.example: The ocean eddy shows anticyclonic rotation, the reverse of the storm's spin.
senses.exampleCN: 这个海洋涡旋呈反气旋式旋转，与风暴的转向相反。
senses.why: The same anti- 'opposite' applies not to weather quality but to the wheel's direction itself.
senses.whyCN: 同一个 anti-「反向」在此不指天气性质，而指风轮本身的转向。

intro.en: Anticyclone is anti- 'against' plus cyclone, from Greek kyklon, a noun from kyklos 'wheel, circle'.
intro.cn: anticyclone 由 anti-「反向」加 cyclone 构成，后者源自希腊语 kyklos「轮、圆」。

items.en: The root *kwekwlos meant 'wheel', a reduplicated form still visible in cycle and wheel.
items.cn: 词根 *kwekwlos 意为「轮」，是叠音形式，仍见于 cycle 与 wheel。

items.en: Kyklos meant 'circle, wheel', giving cycle, bicycle, and encyclopedia.
items.cn: kyklos 意为「圆、轮」，生出 cycle、bicycle、encyclopedia。

items.en: Kyklon named a whirling storm, a wheel of wind.
items.cn: kyklon 指旋转的风暴，一座风之轮。

items.en: Once cyclone named the inward-spiraling storm, meteorologists coined anticyclone for its opposite twin.
items.cn: cyclone 定名内旋风暴后，气象学家为其孪生反面造出 anticyclone。

items.en: In the northern hemisphere anticyclone winds turn clockwise; in the southern, counterclockwise.
items.cn: 北半球反气旋风顺时针转；南半球逆时针转。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the wheel family and anti- weather words; the near-meaning group gathers calm-weather terms.
note.cn: 形近组收「轮」词族与 anti- 气象词；近义组收晴稳天气用语。

entries.definition: The low-pressure twin: winds spiral inward, weather turns stormy.
entries.definitionCN: 低压孪生词：风向内旋，天气转 stormy。

entries.definition: An upward fold in rock layers; looks alike, but the root is geology, not wind.
entries.definitionCN: 背斜，岩层上拱；拼形相近，但属地质而非气象。

entries.definition: All-round education; shares kyklos 'circle' in a bookish way.
entries.definitionCN: 百科全书；以书面方式共享 kyklos「圆」。

entries.definition: A high-pressure area on the weather map, marked H.
entries.definitionCN: 天气图上标注 H 的高压区。

entries.definition: An elongated area of high pressure between two lows.
entries.definitionCN: 两个低压之间的高压脊。

entries.definition: Any system that brings calm, settled conditions.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指带来晴稳天气的系统。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the anti- reversal, the cyclone wheel, and the weather-map picture.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用 anti- 的反向、cyclone 的风轮，以及天气图画面。

normal.en: anti + cyclone: the wheel that turns the opposite way.
normal.cn: anti 加 cyclone：转向相反的风轮。

normal.en: Cyclone spins inward with storms; anticyclone outward with calm.
normal.cn: 气旋内旋带来风暴；反气旋外旋带来平静。

normal.en: On the map, find the letter H: that is the anticyclone.
normal.cn: 在天气图上找字母 H：那就是反气旋。

normal.en: Bicycle shares the wheel root: two wheels.
normal.cn: bicycle 共享「轮」词根：两个轮子。

normal.en: Anticyclonic is its adjective, as in anticyclonic gloom.
normal.cn: 形容词是 anticyclonic，如 anticyclonic gloom。

abstract.en: Picture a giant silent pinwheel turning outward over a quiet city.
abstract.cn: 想象一座巨大无声的风车在城市上空向外旋转。

abstract.en: Picture a week of flat gray fog under an unmoving sky.
abstract.cn: 想象停滞的天空下连日的灰色平雾。

abstract.en: Picture two spinning tops, one blowing outward, one sucking inward.
abstract.cn: 想象两枚旋转的陀螺，一个向外吹，一个向内吸。

examples.en: The anticyclone stalled, so the smog could not disperse.
examples.cn: 反气旋停滞，烟雾无法散去。

examples.en: Autumn anticyclones give crisp, cloudless days.
examples.cn: 秋季反气旋带来干爽无云的日子。

examples.en: Sailors read the anticyclone as a promise of light winds.
examples.cn: 水手把反气旋读作微风将至的许诺。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安台赛克隆」——安稳的天气台风被赛着克隆成了平静版，就是「反气旋」

root: 希腊语 anti-（反向）+ kyklon（旋转的风暴，出自 kyklos「轮」）→ 反气旋；与气旋相反的高压外旋系统。

sensesIntro.en: One sense names the high-pressure system; the other reads the same anti- as a plain reversal of spin.
sensesIntro.cn: 第一义项命名高压系统；第二义项把同一个 anti- 读作转向的单纯反转。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a slowly outward-turning wheel of air with clear skies pinned at its hub
core.cn: 核心意象：缓缓外旋的空气之轮，轮毂上钉着一片晴空

branches.en: The calm line: settled skies under a high.
branches.cn: 平静线：高压之下天空安稳。

branches.en: The haze line: the same stillness can trap smog.
branches.cn: 霾线：同样的静稳也会困住烟雾。

branches.en: The mirror line: anticyclone exists against its storm twin.
branches.cn: 镜像线：反气旋与风暴孪生词相对而立。

branches.en: The map line: the letter H names it in every forecast.
branches.cn: 地图线：每张天气图都用字母 H 标出它。

branches.en: Both senses share one reversed wheel, of weather or of water.
branches.cn: 两个义项共享同一个反转的风轮，或在天空，或在海洋。

intro.en: The compound shows anti- attached to cyclone, a Greek wheel-storm.
intro.cn: 这个复合词是把 anti- 加在希腊语的「风轮」cyclone 上。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin family; the entries record the Greek source.
latinIntro.cn: 该词没有拉丁词族；条目记录希腊语源头。

items.example: It supplies the reversal in anticyclone.
items.exampleCN: 它为 anticyclone 提供反向义。

items.example: It appears in cycle, bicycle, cyclone.

items.exampleCN: 它由 kyklos 构成 cyclone。

items.meaning: a whirling storm of low pressure
items.example: It is the stem the prefix attaches to.

items.meaning: a tropical cyclone in the Atlantic
items.example: It names the same wind wheel in a different ocean.
items.exampleCN: 它指另一片海洋的同一座风轮。

items.meaning: a tropical cyclone in the western Pacific
items.example: It is the Pacific name for the wheel of wind.
items.exampleCN: 它是风之轮在太平洋的名字。

definition_zh: 解毒剂；解药；消除负面影响的事物
definition_en: a medicine that counteracts a poison, or anything that offsets an unpleasant effect
core_image: 一杯清泉倒进中了毒的水缸，毒被中和
scene: 急救箱打开，护士按说明取出小瓶。The doctor gave the boy an antidote after he swallowed the berries.
sceneCN: 这里 antidote 是「解毒剂」（第 1 个义项：对抗毒物的药物）；句意为男孩误食浆果后，医生给他用了解毒剂。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -al 构成，义为「解毒的」
由形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「作为解毒剂地」

senses.title: A remedy against poison
senses.definition: a substance given to counteract the effects of a poison or venom
senses.definitionCN: 用于对抗毒物或毒液效果的物质
senses.example: Snake venom has a specific antidote in most hospitals now.
senses.exampleCN: 如今多数医院都备有蛇毒的特异性解毒剂。
senses.why: Greek antidoton means 'given against': the remedy is literally handed over to stand against the poison.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 antidoton 意为「被给予以对抗之物」：解药就是被递到手上、用来抗毒的东西。

senses.title: Anything that offsets a bad feeling or condition
senses.titleCN: 解药；消除负面影响的办法
senses.definition: something that corrects or removes an unpleasant state, such as boredom or despair
senses.definitionCN: 能纠正或消除不快状态的东西，如无聊或沮丧
senses.example: Laughter is the best antidote to a long winter.
senses.exampleCN: 笑声是漫长冬日最好的解药。
senses.why: If poison can be a mood, the 'given against' can be a joke, a walk, or a friend.
senses.whyCN: 毒既可以是情绪，那么「对抗之物」就可以是一个玩笑、一次散步或一位朋友。

intro.en: Antidote comes from Greek antidoton, 'given against', from anti- 'against' and didonai 'to give'.
intro.cn: antidote 来自希腊语 antidoton「被给予以对抗之物」，由 anti-「对抗」与 didonai「给予」构成。

items.en: The root *deh3- meant 'to give', also visible in donate, dose, and date.
items.cn: 词根 *deh3- 意为「给」，同样见于 donate、dose、date。

items.en: Didonai was the ordinary Greek verb 'to give'.
items.cn: didonai 是希腊语「给」的常用动词。

items.en: Antidoton meant 'a remedy given against' a poison or a wound.
items.cn: antidoton 意为「针对毒物或创伤被给予的药」。

items.en: Latin borrowed it as antidotum, keeping the medical sense.
items.cn: 拉丁语借作 antidotum，保留医学义。

items.en: English took it in the fifteenth century, and by the seventeenth it could mean a cure for feelings too.
items.cn: 英语于十五世纪借入；到十七世纪，它也可以解「心情之毒」了。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers anti- words and the give-root family; the near-meaning group gathers remedies.
note.cn: 形近组收 anti- 词与「给」词根家族；近义组收各种解药。

entries.definition: The body's own weapon against invaders; made inside you, not swallowed.
entries.definitionCN: 身体自造的抗入侵武器；生于体内而非服下。

entries.definition: An amount of medicine given; the give-root visible.
entries.definitionCN: 药剂的一次量；「给」词根可见。

entries.definition: Anecdote is a short story; the words look alike but the roots differ.
entries.definitionCN: anecdote 是轶事；两词拼形相近但词根不同。

entries.definition: Serum against a specific venom, the modern antidote for snakebite.
entries.definitionCN: 抗蛇毒血清，蛇咬伤的现代解毒剂。

entries.definition: Any cure for an illness or a problem.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指治疗疾病或解决问题的办法。

entries.definition: An action taken to cancel out an opposing action.
entries.definitionCN: 为抵消对方行动而采取的措施。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use anti- 'against' and the dose 'give' root, plus the anecdote trap.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用 anti-「对抗」与 dose「给」词根，以及 anecdote 陷阱。

normal.en: anti + dote: given against the poison.
normal.cn: anti 加 dote：被给予以对抗毒物。

normal.en: Dose shares the give-root: something given.
normal.cn: dose 共享「给」词根：被给予之物。

normal.en: Anecdote is a story, antidote is a cure: one letter apart.
normal.cn: anecdote 是故事，antidote 是解药：只差一个字母。

normal.en: Figuratively, humor is an antidote to fear.
normal.cn: 比喻用法：幽默是恐惧的解药。

normal.en: Donate shares the give-root too: to give a gift.
normal.cn: donate 也共享「给」词根：赠予。

abstract.en: Picture dark poison in a glass fading as a clear drop enters.
abstract.cn: 想象杯中黑毒随着一滴清液落入而褪色。

abstract.en: Picture a small vial arriving by courier just in time.
abstract.cn: 想象小药瓶被及时送到。

abstract.en: Picture a friend's joke popping like a pill against gloom.
abstract.cn: 想象朋友的玩笑像药片一样弹出，驱散阴郁。

examples.en: There is no antidote to this poison yet.
examples.cn: 这种毒目前尚无解药。

examples.en: Music was his antidote to city noise.
examples.cn: 音乐是他对抗城市噪音的解药。

examples.en: The antidote must be given within minutes.
examples.cn: 解毒剂必须在几分钟内使用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安替毒」——把毒安安稳稳替换掉的东西，就是「解毒剂」

root: 希腊语 anti-（对抗）+ didonai（给）→ antidoton（被给予以对抗之物）→ 拉丁 antidotum → 英语 antidote；核心意象是「递到手上的解药」。

sensesIntro.en: From the literal poison cure the word widens to any cure for the mind's poisons.
sensesIntro.cn: 由字面的解毒之药扩展到一切解「心中之毒」的东西。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the counter-gift pressed into a poisoned hand
core.cn: 核心意象：被塞进中毒者手中的那件「反向馈赠」

branches.en: The clinic line: vials and serums against real toxins.
branches.cn: 临床线：对抗真实毒物的药瓶与血清。

branches.en: The metaphor line: boredom, gloom, and fear also get their antidotes.
branches.cn: 隐喻线：无聊、阴郁与恐惧也有各自的解药。

branches.en: Both answer something already inside the body or mind.
branches.cn: 两者都针对已进入身体或心里的东西。

branches.en: The timing line: an antidote works only if given in time.
branches.cn: 时机线：解药只有在及时给予时才有效。

branches.en: The garden line: even a walk can be dosed as a cure.
branches.cn: 生活线：连散步也可以像药一样按时服用。

intro.en: The word shows anti- 'against' plus the did- give-root plus the noun ending -ote.
intro.cn: 这个词含 anti-「对抗」、did-「给」词根与名词词尾 -ote。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entry shows antidotum, the borrowing that carried the word westward.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示 antidotum，即把该词带入西方的借形。

items.example: It supplies the against in antidote.
items.exampleCN: 它为 antidote 提供对抗义。

items.example: It appears in dose, donate, date.
It shares the give-root via Latin donum.
items.exampleCN: 它经拉丁语 donum 共享「给」词根。

items.example: It shares anti- historically but means something unpublished, not against.
items.exampleCN: 其 anti- 本指「未刊」，与「对抗」无关。

items.example: It is a modern specialized antidote.
items.exampleCN: 它是现代专用的解毒剂。

definition_en: a contradiction within a statement or between statements; saying opposite things
core_image: 同一张嘴同时说出的两句话互相顶撞
scene: 辩论会上，对手的稿子前后两页互相打架。The judge pointed out the antilogy between the two clauses of the contract.
sceneCN: 这里 antilogy 是「自相矛盾」（第 1 个义项：同一表述内的前后冲突）；句意为法官指出合同两个条款之间的自相矛盾。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ical 构成，义为「自相矛盾的」
由形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「自相矛盾地」

senses.title: A contradiction in words
senses.definition: a contradiction between two statements, or within one statement, so that both cannot stand
senses.definitionCN: 两个陈述之间或同一陈述内部互相矛盾，使二者不能同时成立
senses.example: The speech was ruined by one antilogy: he demanded both speed and caution.
senses.exampleCN: 一次自相矛盾毁掉了整场演讲：他既要求快又要求稳。
senses.why: Greek anti- 'against' plus logia 'speaking' gives 'speech against speech'.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 anti-「对抗」加 logia「言说」即「话与话对着干」。

senses.title: Opposing views held together
senses.definition: a coexistence of opposite positions, especially in a system of thought or belief
senses.definitionCN: 相反立场的并存，尤见于思想或信仰体系
senses.example: The philosophy tolerates the antilogy of fate and freedom.
senses.exampleCN: 这种哲学容忍命运与自由这对矛盾并存。
senses.why: When speeches against speech become systems, the contradiction turns from a flaw into a doctrine.
senses.whyCN: 当话与话的对抗上升为体系，矛盾便从瑕疵变成信条。

intro.en: Antilogy is Greek anti- 'against' plus -logia 'speaking, discourse': speech set against speech.
intro.cn: antilogy 由希腊语 anti-「对抗」加 -logia「言说」构成：互相顶撞的言语。

items.en: The root *leg- meant 'to gather, to speak', feeding logos and the whole -logy family.
items.cn: 词根 *leg- 意为「聚集、言说」，滋养了 logos 与整个 -logy 词族。

items.en: Logos meant 'word, speech, reason', the backbone of logic and dialogue.
items.cn: logos 意为「词、言说、理性」，是 logic 与 dialogue 的骨干。

items.en: The suffix -logia named a kind of speaking or study.
items.cn: 后缀 -logia 指某种言说或研究。

items.en: Anti- meant 'against, opposite', as in antidote and antagonist.
items.cn: anti- 意为「对抗、相反」，如 antidote、antagonist。

items.en: English borrowed antilogy in the sixteenth century as a rhetorician's term for self-contradiction.
items.cn: 英语于十六世纪借入 antilogy，作为修辞学家指自相矛盾的术语。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the -logy word family; the near-meaning group gathers contradiction words.
note.cn: 形近组收 -logy 词族；近义组收「矛盾」类词。

entries.definition: A collection of writings; near twin in sound, but the root is anthos 'flower'.
entries.definitionCN: 选集；读音为近亲，但词根是 anthos「花」。

entries.definition: A speech of praise; shares -logia, a kind of speech.
entries.definitionCN: 颂词；共享 -logia「言说」。

entries.definition: The science of valid reasoning; built on logos, speech as reason.
entries.definitionCN: 逻辑学；建于 logos，即作为理性的言说。

entries.definition: The plain word for saying the opposite of something said or believed.
entries.definitionCN: 指言行或观点相反的常用词。

entries.definition: A statement that seems false but may hold truth.
entries.definitionCN: 看似为假、或含真理的悖论。

entries.definition: A deliberately self-contradictory phrase, such as open secret.
entries.definitionCN: 刻意自相矛盾的修辞，如 open secret。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use anti- 'against' and the -logy 'speech' ending.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用 anti-「对抗」与 -logy「言说」词尾。

normal.en: anti + logy: speech against speech.
normal.cn: anti 加 logy：话与话作对。

normal.en: The -logy here means speaking, as in eulogy.
normal.cn: 这里的 -logy 指言说，如 eulogy。

normal.en: Logic is straight speech; antilogy is speech at war with itself.
normal.cn: logic 是顺理之言；antilogy 是与自己开战的话。

normal.en: Beware of the anthology trap: that word means flower collection.
normal.cn: 小心 anthology 陷阱：那个词是选集。

normal.en: An antilogy can hide in one sentence.
normal.cn: 一个 antilogy 可以藏在一句话里。

abstract.en: Picture two arrows drawn on one page pointing at each other.
abstract.cn: 想象同一页纸上两支互指的箭。

abstract.en: Picture a contract whose first and last lines cancel each other.
abstract.cn: 想象一份首尾条款互相抵消的合同。

abstract.en: Picture a scale that must weigh both yes and no at once.
abstract.cn: 想象一台必须同时称「是」与「否」的天平。

examples.en: The essay's antilogy weakened its argument.
examples.cn: 文章的自相矛盾削弱了论证。

examples.en: Lawyers drafted the clause to avoid any antilogy.
examples.cn: 律师起草条款以避免任何抵触。

examples.en: The critic called the novel's ending an antilogy of hope and despair.
examples.cn: 评论家称小说的结尾是希望与绝望的并置矛盾。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安提逻辑」——同一句话里安了两个互相反对的逻辑，就是「自相矛盾」

root: 希腊语 anti-（对抗）+ -logia（言说）→ 言语相悖 → 自相矛盾；与 logic 同享 logos 词根。

sensesIntro.en: From contradiction in speech the sense widens to opposite positions living inside one system.
sensesIntro.cn: 由言语中的矛盾扩展到同一体系内相反立场的并存。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two statements from one mouth pushing each other over
core.cn: 核心意象：出自同一张嘴的两句话互相推倒对方

branches.en: The rhetoric line: a flaw to be caught and fixed.
branches.cn: 修辞线：一个应被抓出并修正的瑕疵。

branches.en: The philosophy line: a tension to be held, even cherished.
branches.cn: 哲学线：一种应被持守乃至珍视的张力。

branches.en: Both live inside one speaker or one system, not between rivals.
branches.cn: 两者都存在于同一言者或同一体系之内，而非对手之间。

branches.en: The draft line: editors hunt antilogy clause by clause.
branches.cn: 成文线：编辑逐条排查行文矛盾。

branches.en: The faith line: mysteries tolerate what logic cannot resolve.
branches.cn: 信仰线：奥秘容忍逻辑无法化解之事。

intro.en: The word shows anti- plus -logy, the speech suffix of rhetoric.
intro.cn: 这个词是 anti- 加 -logy，即修辞学的言说后缀。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin family; the entries record the Greek source.
latinIntro.cn: 该词没有拉丁词族；条目记录希腊语源头。

items.example: It supplies the clash in antilogy.
items.exampleCN: 它为 antilogy 提供冲突义。

items.example: It appears in logic, dialogue, monologue.

items.exampleCN: 它由 antilogia 构成 antilogy。

items.example: It forms dialogue, speech between two.
It forms contradiction, the Latin cousin.
items.exampleCN: 它构成拉丁近亲词 contradiction。

items.example: In anthology it means flower, not speech.
items.exampleCN: 在 anthology 中意为花，而非言说。

definition_en: a deep-seated feeling of dislike or aversion toward someone or something
core_image: 身体在对方靠近时自动后仰半步
scene: 会议室里他一开口，她就觉得胸口发紧。He felt a lifelong antipathy toward large, crowded parties.
sceneCN: 这里 antipathy 是「反感」（第 1 个义项：根深蒂固的厌恶）；句意为他对大型拥挤聚会怀有一生的反感。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -etic 构成，义为「怀有反感的；引起厌恶的」
同族变体，义同 antipathetic

senses.title: Deep-seated dislike
senses.definition: a settled feeling of strong dislike, often instinctive and long-lasting
senses.definitionCN: 牢固而强烈的厌恶感，常出于本能且持续长久
senses.example: Her antipathy to cockroaches borders on terror.
senses.exampleCN: 她对蟑螂的厌恶近乎恐惧。
senses.why: Greek sympatheia means 'feeling with'; antipatheia means 'feeling against', the body leaning away.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 sympatheia 是「共情」，antipatheia 是「对着感受」：身体不由自主地后仰。

senses.title: Natural opposition between things
senses.definition: an assumed natural incompatibility between things, as in old medicine or chemistry
senses.definitionCN: 旧医学或化学中假定的物体间天然不相容
senses.example: Old alchemists spoke of the antipathy of oil and water.
senses.exampleCN: 旧时的炼金术士谈论油与水之间的天然相克。
senses.why: If sympathy could pull magnets together, its opposite had to push them apart.
senses.whyCN: 既然「共感」能让磁石相吸，它的反面自然能让万物相斥。

intro.en: Antipathy comes from Greek antipatheia, 'feeling against', from anti- 'against' plus pathos 'feeling'.
intro.cn: antipathy 来自希腊语 antipatheia「对着感受」，由 anti-「对抗」加 pathos「感受」构成。

items.en: The root *kwenth- meant 'to suffer, endure', the same root as in patient and passion.
items.cn: 词根 *kwenth- 意为「承受」，与 patient、passion 同根。

items.en: Pathos meant 'feeling, suffering', filling English with sympathy, empathy, and pathetic.
items.cn: pathos 意为「感受、苦楚」，充斥于英语的 sympathy、empathy、pathetic。

items.en: Antipatheia named a feeling that runs against its object.
items.cn: antipatheia 指朝对象反向而行的感受。

items.en: Latin borrowed antipathia with both the human and the natural-science sense.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入 antipathia，兼含人情义与自然科学义。

items.en: English took it in the early seventeenth century; the natural sense faded as science matured.
items.cn: 英语于十七世纪初借入；随科学成熟，「天然相克」义渐淡。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers pathos-family words and anti- kin; the near-meaning group gathers dislike words.
note.cn: 形近组收 pathos 词族与 anti- 亲戚；近义组收「厌恶」类词。

entries.definition: Feeling with someone, pity or understanding; the same shape with sym-.
entries.definitionCN: 同情、体恤；同一构形，前缀换为 sym-。

entries.definition: Feeling nothing at all; neither love nor hate.
entries.definitionCN: 冷漠、无感；既不爱也不恨。

entries.definition: A protein against invaders; shares anti- but nothing of feeling.
entries.definitionCN: 抗体；共享 anti- 但与感受无关。

entries.definition: A strong wish to turn away from something.
entries.definitionCN: 强烈想要避开的意愿。

entries.definition: Open unfriendliness, often shown in action.
entries.definitionCN: 公开的敌意，常表现于行动。

entries.definition: Intense disgust that fights back against its object.
entries.definitionCN: 强烈的排斥与嫌恶。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use anti- 'against' and the pathos 'feeling' root.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用 anti-「对抗」与 pathos「感受」词根。

normal.en: anti + pathy: feeling against someone.
normal.cn: anti 加 pathy：对人反向的感受。

normal.en: Sympathy feels with; antipathy feels against.
normal.cn: sympathy 同感；antipathy 反感。

normal.en: Apathy feels nothing; antipathy feels the opposite.
normal.cn: apathy 无感；antipathy 是反向的感受。

normal.en: Pathos also gives empathy and pathetic.
normal.cn: pathos 还生出 empathy 与 pathetic。

normal.en: The plural antipathies means a set of dislikes.
normal.cn: 复数 antipathies 指一箩筐的厌恶。

abstract.en: Picture your chair sliding back an inch as a stranger sits down.
abstract.cn: 想象陌生人坐下时，你的椅子不自觉后滑一寸。

abstract.en: Picture two magnets that refuse to touch, sliding apart.
abstract.cn: 想象两块拒绝相触、彼此滑开的磁石。

abstract.en: Picture a long-standing frown that appears before any words.
abstract.cn: 想象一句话未出口，眉头早已皱起。

examples.en: Their antipathy was obvious from the first handshake.
examples.cn: 从第一次握手起，他们的互相厌恶就已显露。

examples.en: He has an antipathy to bureaucracy of any kind.
examples.cn: 他对任何形式的官僚作风都反感。

examples.en: Regional antipathies complicated the negotiations.
examples.cn: 地域间的相互反感使谈判复杂化。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安提怕死」——一见面就安提（抬）着怕死的架势，就是「反感、厌恶」

root: 希腊语 anti-（对抗）+ pathos（感受）→ antipatheia（对着感受）→ 英语 antipathy；与 sympathy 相对，是深植的反感。

sensesIntro.en: From human dislike the word once stretched to the push-pull of objects themselves.
sensesIntro.cn: 由人的厌恶曾一度延伸到物体之间的相斥。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the body leaning away before the mind explains why
core.cn: 核心意象：心智尚未解释，身体已先行后仰

branches.en: The temper line: a personal, often lifelong dislike.
branches.cn: 性情线：个人的、常伴终身的厌恶。

branches.en: The old-science line: oil and water, magnet and lodestone.
branches.cn: 旧学线：油与水、磁与石之间的相克。

branches.en: Both are forces of repulsion, not of argument.
branches.cn: 两者都是排斥之力，而非争论之理。

branches.en: The mirror line: sympathy is its exact twin with the opposite sign.
branches.cn: 镜像线：sympathy 是符号相反的孪生词。

branches.en: The group line: antipathies between regions outlast treaties.
branches.cn: 群体线：地域间的憎恶比条约更长寿。

intro.en: The word is anti- plus pathos plus the noun ending -y, with a productive feeling-family.
intro.cn: 这个词是 anti- 加 pathos 加名词词尾 -y，所属「感受」词族非常高产。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entry shows antipathia, the borrowed form behind the English word.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示 antipathia，即英语词背后的借形。

items.example: It supplies the against in antipathy.
items.exampleCN: 它为 antipathy 提供对抗义。

items.example: It appears in sympathy, empathy, pathetic.

items.exampleCN: 它由 antipatheia 构成 antipathy。

items.example: It forms empathy, feeling into another.
It forms telepathy, feeling at a distance.

definition_en: the exact opposite point on the globe, or a person or thing that is the complete opposite
core_image: 地球两端各站一人，脚心相对
scene: 地理课上，教授把一根线穿过地球仪的两点。The antipode of Shanghai lies somewhere in the pampas of Argentina.
sceneCN: 这里 antipode 是「对跖点」（第 1 个义项：地球上正对的另一点）；句意为上海的对跖点位于阿根廷潘帕斯草原一带。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -al 构成，义为「对跖的；正相反的」
由本词加 -an 构成，义为「对跖的；（大写）澳新的」

senses.title: The opposite point on the globe
senses.definition: the point on the earth's surface directly opposite another point, through the center of the earth
senses.definitionCN: 地球表面上穿过地心与另一点正对的点
senses.example: Dig a hole straight through the earth and you would reach its antipode.
senses.exampleCN: 沿直线穿过地心挖洞，你会抵达它的对跖点。
senses.why: Greek anti- 'opposite' plus pous 'foot': the place where people's feet point against yours.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 anti-「相反」加 pous「脚」：那里的人脚心正对着你的脚。

senses.title: A complete opposite
senses.definition: a person or thing that is the exact opposite of another in character or quality
senses.definitionCN: 性格或品质上与另一者完全相反的人或物
senses.example: In temperament he is the antipode of his twin brother.
senses.exampleCN: 论性情，他是孪生兄弟的完全反面。
senses.why: The globe metaphor travels inward: between two people a whole earth of difference can lie.
senses.whyCN: 地球的隐喻转入人间：两个人之间也可能隔着整个地球的差异。

intro.en: Antipode is Greek antipous, 'having the feet opposite', from anti- 'against' plus pous 'foot'.
intro.cn: antipode 即希腊语 antipous「脚心相对的」，由 anti-「相反」加 pous「脚」构成。

items.en: The root *ped- meant 'foot', the same root as in pedal and podiatry.
items.cn: 词根 *ped- 意为「脚」，与 pedal、podiatry 同根。

items.en: Pous meant 'foot'; it also lives in tripod and polyp.
items.cn: pous 意为「脚」；还保留在 tripod、polyp 中。

items.en: Antipous described people standing feet-to-feet on opposite sides of the earth.
items.cn: antipous 描述站在地球两侧、脚心相对的人。

items.en: Greek used the plural hoi antipodes, 'the men with feet opposite ours'.
items.cn: 希腊语用复数 hoi antipodes，即「脚与我们相对的人们」。

items.en: Latin kept antipodes for the southern hemisphere; English later cut out a singular antipode.
items.cn: 拉丁语以 antipodes 称南半球；英语后来切出单数 antipode。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the foot-root family and anti- kin; the near-meaning group gathers opposite words.
note.cn: 形近组收「脚」词根家族与 anti- 亲戚；近义组收「相反」类词。

entries.definition: A feeling of dislike; starts alike but the root is pathos 'feeling'.
entries.definitionCN: 反感；开头相像，但词根是 pathos「感受」。

entries.definition: The adjective of antipode, as in antipodal points.
entries.definitionCN: antipode 的形容词，如对跖点。

entries.definition: A three-footed stand; shares pous 'foot' with a friendly prefix.
entries.definitionCN: 三脚架；共享 pous「脚」，前缀亲善得多。

entries.definition: The plain word for the other of two contrary things.
entries.definitionCN: 表示相反之物的常用词。

entries.definition: The reversed version of a statement.
entries.definitionCN: 陈述的逆反形式。

entries.definition: A matching counterpart, equal rather than opposed.
entries.definitionCN: 对应的对应物，强调对应而非对立。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use anti- and the pous 'foot' root, plus the globe picture.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用 anti- 与 pous「脚」词根，以及地球的画面。

normal.en: anti + pode: feet pointing against yours.
normal.cn: anti 加 pode：脚心与你相对。

normal.en: Pous also gives tripod and pedal's cousin pod-.
normal.cn: pous 还见于 tripod 与 pedal 的近亲 pod-。

normal.en: The Antipodes is the old name for Australia and New Zealand.
normal.cn: the Antipodes 是澳新的旧称。

normal.en: Antipodal points are connected by one straight line through the core.
normal.cn: 对跖点之间是一条穿过地心的直线。

normal.en: Figuratively, his values are the antipode of mine.
normal.cn: 比喻用法：他的价值观与我截然相反。

abstract.en: Picture two chalk lines meeting at the center of a globe.
abstract.cn: 想象两条粉笔线在地球仪中心相遇。

abstract.en: Picture a hole through the planet, cool and dark, ending in sunlight.
abstract.cn: 想象一条贯穿地球的洞，幽暗而凉，尽头是阳光。

abstract.en: Picture two brothers standing back to back, facing opposite horizons.
abstract.cn: 想象兄弟俩背靠背而立，面向相反的地平线。

examples.en: Madrid's antipode lies near Wellington in New Zealand.
examples.cn: 马德里的对跖点在新西兰惠灵顿附近。

examples.en: Her austerity is the antipode of his extravagance.
examples.cn: 她的简朴是他的奢靡的对立面。

examples.en: The two cultures are antipodes in their attitude to time.
examples.cn: 这两种文化的时间观截然相反。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安提剖」——从地球这头剖到那头正对着的一点，就是「对跖点」

root: 希腊语 anti-（相反）+ pous（脚）→ antipous（脚心相对者）→ 对跖点；引申为截然相反的人或事物。

sensesIntro.en: The geographic opposite point gives birth to the figurative complete opposite.
sensesIntro.cn: 地理上的对跖点孕育出比喻中的完全对立。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two people on opposite sides of the globe, feet meeting at the core
core.cn: 核心意象：分处地球两侧的两个人，脚在地心相遇

chain: ONE STRAIGHT LINE THROUGH THE CORE

branches.en: The geography line: one straight line through the center of the earth.
branches.cn: 地理线：一条穿过地心的直线。

branches.en: The character line: between two people, a whole earth of difference.
branches.cn: 性格线：两人之间隔着整个地球的差异。

branches.en: Both measure distance at its absolute maximum.
branches.cn: 两者都度量最大限度的距离。

branches.en: The history line: the Antipodes named lands once thought unreachable.
branches.cn: 历史线：the Antipodes 曾指被认为遥不可及的大陆。

branches.en: The mirror line: the antipode exists only against its twin.
branches.cn: 镜像线：对跖点唯有相对孪生者而存在。

intro.en: The word is anti- plus the pous foot-root plus a noun ending.
intro.cn: 这个词是 anti- 加 pous「脚」词根，再加名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin family; the entries record the Greek source.
latinIntro.cn: 该词没有拉丁词族；条目记录希腊语源头。

items.example: It supplies the opposition in antipode.
items.exampleCN: 它为 antipode 提供相反义。

items.example: It appears in tripod, polyp, podiatry.

items.exampleCN: 它由 antipous 构成 antipode。
它构成 pedal 与 pedestrian。

definition_zh: 古物收藏家；古旧文物的；爱好古物的
definition_en: a person who studies or collects old and rare things, or relating to the study of antiquities
core_image: 一屋子旧书与铜器，主人用白手套轻抚书脊
scene: 旧书店深处，煤油灯下的书堆泛着黄。The antiquarian spent his weekends hunting for maps of the old harbor.
sceneCN: 这里 antiquarian 是「古物收藏家」（第 1 个义项：搜集研究古物之人）；句意为这位古物爱好者周末都在寻找旧港湾地图。

pos.zh: 古物收藏家；文物研究者

derivatives.zh: 同族词，义为「古物研究者」，更古雅的说法
由本词加 -ism 构成，义为「古物癖；好古之风」

senses.title: A collector or student of antiquities
senses.titleCN: 古物收藏家；文物研究者
senses.definition: a person who collects, studies, or deals in old books, maps, coins, and other relics of the past
senses.definitionCN: 收集、研究或经营旧书、古地图、古币等旧物的人
senses.example: The antiquarian could date a coin by the wear on its edge.
senses.exampleCN: 这位古物收藏家凭边缘的磨损就能断定古币的年代。
senses.why: Latin antiquus 'old' plus the agent ending -arian names the person devoted to old things.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 antiquus「古老的」加表人后缀 -arian，点出倾心旧物之人。

senses.title: Relating to old and rare things
senses.definition: connected with the collecting or study of antiquities, or old-fashioned in flavor
senses.definitionCN: 与古物收藏研究相关，或带有古旧风味的
senses.example: The library keeps its antiquarian maps in a dark, cool room.
senses.exampleCN: 图书馆把古籍地图存放在阴凉的暗室。
senses.why: The adjective keeps the noun's devotion: anything flavored with age can be antiquarian.
senses.whyCN: 形容词保留了名词的痴迷：凡带着岁月风味的东西皆可称 antiquarian。

intro.en: Antiquarian is antiquary reshaped: Latin antiquus 'old' plus the person-ending -arian.
intro.cn: antiquarian 由 antiquary 变形而来：拉丁语 antiquus「古老的」加表人后缀 -arian。

items.en: The root *ant- meant 'front, before', the same root that feeds ante- and ancient.
items.cn: 词根 *ant- 意为「前面、在先」，同样滋养 ante- 与 ancient。

items.en: Antiquus meant 'old, former', source of antique and antiquity.
items.cn: antiquus 意为「古老的、从前的」，是 antique 与 antiquity 的来源。

items.en: Late Latin had antiquarius, a keeper or maker of old things.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语已有 antiquarius，指旧物的守护者或制作者。

items.en: English had antiquary first, then built the longer antiquarian in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 英语先有 antiquary，十七世纪又构成更长的 antiquarian。

items.en: Today the word lives mostly in bookshops, auctions, and scholarly societies.
items.cn: 如今该词主要活跃于旧书店、拍卖行与学术团体。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the antiquus family and look-alike -arian words; the near-meaning group gathers old-things words.
note.cn: 形近组收 antiquus 词族与易混 -arian 词；近义组收「旧物」类词。

entries.definition: Ancient times, or a very old object.
entries.definitionCN: 古代；古老之物。

entries.definition: An old collectible object, or very old in style.
entries.definitionCN: 古董；古式的。

entries.definition: Relating to land and farming; shares the -arian ending only.
entries.definitionCN: 土地与农业的；仅共享 -arian 词尾。

entries.definition: Anyone who gathers things of a kind.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指各类收藏者。

entries.definition: A keeper of records and documents.
entries.definitionCN: 档案与文书的保管者。

entries.definition: A keeper of a museum's collections.
entries.definitionCN: 博物馆藏品的策展守护人。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the antiquus 'old' root and the -arian person ending.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用 antiquus「古老」词根与 -arian 表人词尾。

normal.en: antiqu + arian: a person devoted to old things.
normal.cn: antiqu 加 arian：倾心旧物的人。

normal.en: Antique and antiquity share the same old root.
normal.cn: antique 与 antiquity 同根。

normal.en: An antiquarian bookshop sells old, rare books.
normal.cn: antiquarian bookshop 卖古籍珍本。

normal.en: The older word is antiquary, one letter shorter.
normal.cn: 更旧的词是 antiquary，少一个字母。

normal.en: -arian also gives librarian and vegetarian: person endings.
normal.cn: -arian 还见于 librarian、vegetarian：都是表人词尾。

abstract.en: Picture a magnifying glass hovering over a faded signature.
abstract.cn: 想象放大镜悬在褪色的签名上方。

abstract.en: Picture shelves of leather spines smelling of dust and time.
abstract.cn: 想象一排皮革书脊，散发尘土与岁月的气味。

abstract.en: Picture white gloves turning the pages of a cracked map.
abstract.cn: 想象白手套翻动脆裂的古地图。

examples.en: The antiquarian paid a fortune for the first edition.
examples.cn: 这位古物爱好者花巨资买下初版书。

examples.en: Her antiquarian interests began with grandmother's coins.
examples.cn: 她的好古之趣始于祖母的旧硬币。

examples.en: The sale featured antiquarian prints of the city.
examples.cn: 拍卖会推出了这座城市的古版画。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安提葵」——安安静静对着古葵（老物件）研究的人，就是「古物收藏家」

root: 拉丁语 antiquus（古老的）+ -arius（从事者）→ 拉丁 antiquarius → 英语 antiquarian；核心意象是「以旧物为业与乐的人」。

sensesIntro.en: The devoted person and the adjective describing their world share one love of age.
sensesIntro.cn: 痴迷的人与形容其天地的形容词共享同一种对岁月的爱。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: hands in white gloves reaching into the dust of time
core.cn: 核心意象：戴着白手套的手伸进时间的尘埃

branches.en: The person line: the hunter of books, coins, and maps.
branches.cn: 人物线：追逐古籍、古币与古地图的猎人。

branches.en: The thing line: shops, prints, and societies with the same name.
branches.cn: 物象线：同名书店、版画与学会。

branches.en: Both honor the past by keeping its leftovers whole.
branches.cn: 两者都通过完整保存遗存来致敬过去。

branches.en: The flavor line: antiquarian can mean pleasantly old-fashioned.
branches.cn: 风味线：antiquarian 也可指令人愉悦的古雅。

branches.en: The scholarship line: antiquarians were historians' amateur ancestors.
branches.cn: 学术线：古物研究者是历史学家的业余先祖。

intro.en: The word is the antiqu- 'old' root plus the -arian person ending, a Latin doublet.
intro.cn: 这个词是 antiqu-「古老」词根加 -arian 表人词尾的拉丁组合。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entry shows antiquarius, the late-Latin keeper of old things.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示 antiquarius，即晚期拉丁语的旧物守护者。

items.example: It forms antemeridian, from the same ancient root.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 antemeridian，出自同一古老词根。

items.example: It shares the *ant- front root through Old French.
items.exampleCN: 它经古法语共享 *ant- 词根。

items.example: It is the shorter, older form of antiquarian.
items.exampleCN: 它是 antiquarian 更短更旧的形式。

items.example: Librarian shares the -arian ending with antiquarian.
items.exampleCN: librarian 与 antiquarian 共享 -arian 词尾。

latinEntries.meaning: a keeper or dealer in old things
latinEntries.meaningCN: 旧物的守护者或经营者
